kultivator.technique.cloud_step.desc: Jump again in mid-air on clouds of qi; no fall damage right after.
kultivator.technique.qi_palm.desc: A blast of qi rushes forward and strikes monsters.
kultivator.technique.flying_sword.desc: Stand on your sword and fly. Drains qi every second.
kultivator.technique.divine_sense.desc: Spread the sense of your soul: monsters glow and nearby ores reveal themselves.
kultivator.technique.buddha_palm.desc: A giant golden palm falls from the sky onto your foes.
kultivator.technique.dharma_form.desc: Become a towering Dharma avatar: bigger, stronger, tougher.
kultivator.technique.dao_domain.desc: Unfold your Dao around you; monsters inside suffer its law.
kultivator.technique.sword_qi.desc: A crescent of sword qi cuts through every monster in a line.
kultivator.technique.thousand_swords.des: Swords of light rain on every monster around you.
kultivator.technique.flame_palm.desc: A cone of spirit fire burns the monsters in front of you.
kultivator.technique.phoenix_flame.desc: A phoenix of fire soars forward, burning all monsters in its path.
kultivator.technique.frost_lotus.desc: A lotus of frost blooms and freezes monsters around you.
kultivator.technique.glacier_prison.desc: Seal your target and the monsters near it in ice.
kultivator.technique.thunder_palm.desc: Lightning strikes your target and jumps to more monsters.
kultivator.technique.heavenly_thunder.de: Call down heavenly thunder on the monsters around you.
kultivator.technique.iron_body.desc: Your body hardens like iron and throws back blows.
kultivator.technique.mountain_stomp.desc: Stomp like a falling mountain and launch monsters into the air.
kultivator.technique.spring_of_life.desc: Heal yourself, your friends and your pets.
kultivator.technique.life_drain.desc: Drain the life of nearby monsters to heal yourself.
kultivator.technique.shadow_step.desc: Step through the shadows to behind the monster you look at.
kultivator.technique.gale.desc: A storm wind hurls monsters away and hides you.
kultivator.technique.space_blink.desc: Fold space and appear where you look.
kultivator.technique.space_prison.desc: Lock the space around monsters, holding them in place.
kultivator.core.hardcore_on: Hardcore breakthroughs ON: a failed breakthrough drops you one realm.
kultivator.core.hardcore_off: Hardcore breakthroughs OFF: a failed breakthrough only causes a Qi Deviation.
kultivator.core.root_already: Your spiritual root is already known: %s.
kultivator.core.root_result: The test is done. You have a %s.
kultivator.screen.title: Cultivation
advancement.kultivator.root.title: Path of Cultivation
advancement.kultivator.root.description: Every immortal was once a mortal.
